        ### Question

        ### Options

opb. 50-year-old man with a history of strep infection
opc. 8-year-old boy who undergoes no treatment
opd. 38-year-old man with sickle cell trait
ope. 18-year-old man treated with corticosteroids

### Reasoning Chains per Option:
